_comment: Topics deliberately OUTSIDE the two hand-tuned benchmark templates (COVID corticosteroids, SGLT2 HFpEF). They span pharmacology, supplements, and behavioral interventions, each with a real randomized-trial evidence base, so the pipeline must succeed without any topic-specific hardcoding or a forced known-source anchor. Run with: python scripts/generalization_baseline.py run --topics docs/benchmarks/generalization_topics.json

topics.topic: Tranexamic acid versus placebo for all-cause mortality in adults with acute traumatic brain injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
topics.note: Large RCT base (e.g. CRASH-3); tests acute-care mortality synthesis far from the COVID template.

topics.topic: Probiotics versus placebo or no probiotics for the prevention of antibiotic-associated diarrhea in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
topics.note: Many small RCTs, dichotomous outcome; stresses screening and dedup at scale.

topics.topic: Melatonin versus placebo for sleep onset latency in adults with primary insomnia: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
topics.note: Continuous outcome (minutes), MD/SMD path; different effect-measure machinery than OR.

topics.topic: Vitamin D supplementation versus placebo for the prevention of acute respiratory tract infections in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
topics.note: Heterogeneous dosing and populations; should force random-effects and an honest heterogeneity discussion.

topics.topic: Mindfulness-based interventions versus usual care for depressive symptoms in adults with chronic pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
topics.note: Behavioral intervention, SMD on a rating scale; tests non-drug PICO extraction and writing.
